description: This file defines the DetailedPerformanceReviewModel class, which represents a detailed performance review in the OrangeHRM system API. It includes properties for review details such as job title, subunit, review period, due date, and status, along with logic to initialize from a PerformanceReview entity and serialize to an array. It acts as a data transfer object (DTO) for performance review data within the API.

classes.name: DetailedPerformanceReviewModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed performance review data, including related entities and review statuses, used in the OrangeHRM API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PerformanceReview entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model to an array including the performance review data and self-review status.
